runtimeProjection.definitionEn: Very severe or intense, especially when describing pain or a problem.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: He went to the clinic with acute stomach pain.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: Something added to a group or place that was already there.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: The new wing is a welcome addition to the library.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: A particular period in history marked by shared conditions or events.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: The invention changed travel during the industrial age.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: Used to show that you agree with a suggestion or request.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: All right, send me the schedule when you can.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: In a satisfactory or acceptable condition, though not necessarily excellent.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: The engine sounds all right after the repair.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: A public place where fish and other water animals are kept for people to see.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: The aquarium opened a new tank for rescued sea turtles.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: A trained professional who plans buildings and prepares their designs.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: The architect showed us a model of the new library.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: An act of violence intended to hurt a person or damage a place.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: The report described an attack on the border village.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: A flexible bag that expands when filled with air or another gas.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: The red balloon floated into the trees.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: A small wound or mark made when teeth or an insect pierce skin.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: A mosquito bite left a red spot on his ankle.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: Across a wide area, range of people, or set of subjects.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: The proposal was broadly supported by residents across the city.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: To question whether a decision, claim, or authority is correct.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: Residents challenged the plan at the public meeting.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: A person or team that has won an important competition.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: The national champion returned to train with the younger players.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: To ask someone to pay a particular amount for a product or service.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: The repair shop charged a fair price for each replacement part.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: Connected with buying and selling goods or providing services for profit.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: The street has become a busy commercial district.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: So interesting that it holds someone's attention.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: The mystery novel was so compelling that I read it in one night.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: To give most of your attention or effort to one thing.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: I need a quiet room to concentrate on this report.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: To make someone feel worried about a possible problem or risk.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: The sudden drop in sales concerned the whole team.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: To show that information or a plan is correct and certain.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: Please confirm the meeting time by replying to this message.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: To move forward very slowly, especially because progress is difficult.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: Traffic crawled along the highway for several miles.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: A living animal or other being, especially one that can move.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: A tiny sea creature hid beneath the smooth rock.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: Words that point out faults or weaknesses in someone's work or actions.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: The review offered useful criticism of the first draft.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: To move away from a planned route, direction, or standard.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: The hikers deviated from the marked path to avoid flooding.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: By a direct route, without changing direction or stopping.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: We flew direct from Hanoi to Singapore.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: To guide actors and creative work while a film is being made.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: A local filmmaker directed the documentary about the harbor.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: Two times as much, as many, or as often as something else.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: This version costs double what the older model does.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: At some point within the time when an event or activity happens.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: Please keep your phone silent during the performance.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: Completely correct in every detail, with no important difference.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: Can you give me the exact number of boxes in storage?

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: The act of giving something and receiving something else in return.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: The exchange of ideas helped both teams improve the design.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: To give one thing and receive something else in return.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: At the market, she exchanged three apples for a loaf of bread.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: At a great distance from a particular place.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: Our village is far from the nearest railway station.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: Willing to share information or speak honestly when someone asks.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: The witness was forthcoming about what she had seen.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: Fuel formed over a very long time from ancient plants or animals.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: The factory still burns fossil fuel to heat its boilers.

runtimeProjection.vietnamese: học sinh hoặc sinh viên năm nhất
runtimeProjection.definitionEn: A student in the first year of a high school or college program.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: As a freshman, he joined the campus photography club.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: A cord that burns slowly to set off a firework or explosive device.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: The firework's fuse burned down before it exploded.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: An empty space between two things or between parts of something.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: A narrow gap under the door let in cold air.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: Something that you do regularly, often without thinking about it.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: Reading before bed became a relaxing habit for him.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: Deep respect shown for a person's character, actions, or achievements.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: The school named a library in her honour.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: Used at the start of a sentence to say that you hope something will happen.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: Hopefully, the rain will stop before the outdoor concert.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: A small picture on a screen that represents a program, action, or item.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: Tap the magnifying-glass icon to search the page.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: The quality of being honest and following strong moral principles.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: Her integrity earned the trust of colleagues and clients.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: The condition of being whole, complete, and free from damage.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: Engineers checked the bridge's integrity after the heavy storm.

runtimeProjection.vietnamese: dành cho trẻ em và thanh thiếu niên
runtimeProjection.definitionEn: Designed for or intended to be used by younger people.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: The center opened a junior climbing class for children.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: Only a short time before the present moment or another event.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: The parcel just arrived, so I haven't opened it yet.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: Recognized or familiar to people because they have heard about it.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: The village is known for its quiet lakeside market.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: An elected person who helps create or change laws for a country or region.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: The lawmaker met local families before proposing the new rule.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: To cause a particular result or make it more likely to happen.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: Skipping regular maintenance can lead to costly repairs.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: The act of guiding a group toward a shared goal.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: Strong leadership kept the volunteers focused during the storm.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: To give someone permission to do something they want to do.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: The coach let Maya choose the team captain.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: To allow an action or event to happen without trying to stop it.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: The open gate let the dog wander into the garden.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: Likely to experience something undesirable in a particular situation.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: Without shade, young plants are liable to dry out.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: Connected with language, the way it works, or its study.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: The team compared linguistic patterns across several regional dialects.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: To promote a product or service so that people will buy it.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: The company marketed its new app to local teachers.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: A person who belongs to a group, club, or organization.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: Each member can borrow three books at a time.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: A specific point in time when something happens or changes.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: At that moment, the lights came back on.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: A very short period of time, often lasting only a few seconds.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: Wait a moment while I check the address.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: The basic character or qualities that make a person or thing what it is.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: Patience is part of her calm nature.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: A person with an official position and particular duties or authority.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: A park officer explained the new trail rules.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: Used after a number to describe a rate measured out of one hundred.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: The bank added a two per cent fee to the transfer.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: A proportion that tells how many parts there are in every hundred.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: Only ten per cent of the class chose that answer.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: Small or light enough to be carried or moved easily.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: The portable speaker fits into the side pocket of my bag.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: Well known and important, so that many people notice or respect you.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: A prominent scientist spoke at the opening ceremony.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: Making very little noise or having very little activity around you.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: We found a quiet corner to read during lunch.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: To bring people together for a shared public purpose or event.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: The organizers rallied neighbors to protect the park.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: Located at the back of something rather than at its front.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: We entered through the rear door beside the kitchen.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: Help given to people who are suffering or facing a serious emergency.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: Relief workers brought clean water to the flooded town.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: A reduction in pain or discomfort after treatment or a change.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: The cool cloth brought relief to her aching forehead.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: To give money back to the person or organization that lent it.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: I will repay the loan in monthly instalments.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: A person who lives in a particular place, usually for a long time.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: Every resident received a notice about the water repairs.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: A period when you stop working or moving to recover your energy.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: After the long walk, we sat down for a short rest.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: The hard natural material that forms the ground and mountains.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: The path winds across bare rock above the valley.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: An official list of people who belong to a team or group.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: The coach posted the final roster beside the gym entrance.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: To take turns in a planned order so each person has a role.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: The students rotate through each station every ten minutes.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: To turn around a central point while remaining in the same general place.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: The display rotates slowly above the entrance.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: A person who studies a subject deeply and knows a great deal about it.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: The scholar spent years studying ancient maps of the coast.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: To remove a thin layer or substance by rubbing with a hard edge.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: She scraped dried paint off the window with a blade.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: A group of related things that belong or are used together.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: The kitchen came with a set of four matching cups.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: To take someone's hand and move it briefly as a greeting or agreement.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: They shook hands after signing the contract.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: A person or organization that owns part of a company through shares.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: Each shareholder received an update about the merger.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: A set period when a person is scheduled to work.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: Nora starts her evening shift at the hospital at four.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: A change in the way something is arranged, understood, or done.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: The survey showed a shift in public opinion.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: A short period during which a particular kind of weather or activity lasts.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: A spell of warm weather brought everyone back to the beach.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: To extend over a larger area or reach more places over time.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: Dark clouds spread across the valley before sunset.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: To be upright on your feet rather than sitting or lying down.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: Please stand near the window while I adjust the light.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: To try very hard to do something that is difficult for you.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: She struggled to keep the canoe steady in the wind.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: Cloth made by weaving or knitting fibers together for practical use.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: The workshop turns recycled fibers into durable textiles for bags.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: The number of people killed or injured by an accident or disaster.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: The full toll of deaths and injuries from the storm became clear by morning.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: Complete in every part, with nothing missing or left out.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: The total darkness made it hard to find the path.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: Including all parts together as one combined amount or number.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: Their total monthly expenses rose after the move.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: A skilled job that people learn through training and practical work.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: After training, she found steady work in the building trade.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: A mass of cells that grows abnormally in a person's body.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: The scan showed a small tumor near the patient's kidney.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: Being the only one of its kind, with no exact match elsewhere.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: The manuscript is the only surviving copy, so it is unique.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: By going through a particular place or using a particular method.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: We sent the signed form via the school office.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: Wanted and received with pleasure by a person or group.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: Extra volunteers are always welcome at the shelter.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: To take back a statement, offer, or request that you made earlier.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: She withdrew her complaint after the issue was resolved.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: Weighing little and easy to lift or carry.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: This suitcase is light enough to carry.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: Pale in color or close to white, rather than dark or strong.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: She chose a light blue scarf for the spring concert.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: To make something begin burning by giving it a flame.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: Maya lit a candle before the power went out.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: A feeling of doubt that makes someone cautious about agreeing.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: He accepted the offer, though he had one reservation about the schedule.

runtimeProjection.definitionEn: To supply water to a plant so that it can grow.
runtimeProjection.exampleEn: Water the plants every morning.
